title: login.sh
puzzle:
**SSH session established.** Welcome to LEO-OS.

The terminal wants a password. The only clue on screen:

```
password hint: the day you asked the most important question
format: DDMMYYYY
```
hints: Dots, dashes and spaces don't matter. Only the digits.
